title: Initial QA capture retains allocated route time within both transports
steps: Run run.cmd and verify all eight tests pass without skips.
expect: Initial capture with 45000 ms pages and 90000 ms routes remains live after 60001 ms and expires at 150000 ms.
The 150000 ms host deadline is below the existing 175000 ms web and 180000 ms native transports.
Each phase retains its cap, route-free deadlines remain unchanged, and final-check deadlines remain below their web transport.
Queue time is retained through nested deadlines; caller cancellation propagates and disposing a completed request removes its timer.

tests: initial capture keeps its route time and ends before both transports
queue time consumes the original deadline even when the browser creates its own deadline later
caller cancellation interrupts a queued or running request without waiting for either budget
disposing a completed request removes its deadline timer
